a fully valid, step-by-step proof—no "sorry," etc.
1:10 proof ratio. Perform a complete formal verification of the following Zig source file in the Lean 4 language. All proofs must be strictly term-based—the keyword by must not appear anywhere in the output. Work with a 1:10 code-to-proof ratio.
Required term-mode constructs (ALLOWED, use these):
fun, match ... with, Eq.refl, ⟨_, ⟩(anonymous constructor), And.intro, Or.inl, Or.inr, Exists.intro, False.elim, absurd, congrArg, congrFun, congr, Eq.subst, Eq.mp, Eq.mpr, Eq.symm, Eq.trans, Nat.rec, Nat.recOn, Nat.casesOn, List.rec, List.recOn, if ... then ... else, term-mode let, show, have (term-mode, non-tactic), suffices (term-mode), @-explicit application, (· : Type) type annotation, nomatch, nofun, Nat.zero, Nat.succ, Nat.add, Nat.mul, Nat.le, Nat.lt, Nat.le_refl, Nat.le_step, Nat.le_trans, Nat.zero_le, Nat.succ_le_succ, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le, Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.mul_pos, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero, Nat.sub_add_cancel, List.length, List.length_cons, List.length_nil, List.get, List.map, List.foldl, List.foldr, List.zipWith, List.replicate, List.length_replicate, List.append, List.prod, Array.size, Array.get, Array.set, Array.mk, Fin.mk, Fin.val, Subtype.mk, Subtype.val, Subtype.property, Bool.true, Bool.false, Bool.and, Bool.or, Decidable.isTrue, Decidable.isFalse, dite, ite, Function.comp, id, absurd, Not, propext, funext (term-mode, like funext fun x => ...), Prod.mk, Prod.fst, Prod.snd, Sigma.mk, PSigma.mk, Unit.unit, True.intro, HAdd.hAdd, HMul.hMul, HSub.hSub, HDiv.hDiv, HMod.hMod, BEq.beq, LT.lt, LE.le, GT.gt, GE.ge, Nat.decEq, Nat.decLe, Nat.decLt, List.beq, type class instances, structure definitions, inductive type definitions, def, theorem, lemma, example, structure, inductive, class, instance, namespace, section, variable, open (for modules, not open Classical), #check, #eval, noncomputable (if working with Float), partial (if required for recursion), where, deriving.
The following elements are completely and unconditionally PROHIBITED in any part of the output. The use of any of them invalidates the result:
by (tactic block opener — this is the only keyword that disallows ALL tactics, since tactics can only exist within a by-block), sorry, admit, axiom (custom axioms — Lean’s built-in axioms such as propext, funext, and Quot.sound are allowed), Decidable.em (excluded third — classical logic), Classical.choice, Classical.em, Classical.byContradiction, Classical.propDecidable, open Classical, native_decide, decide (automated decision), Lean.Elab.Tactic.* (any elab tactic).
IMPORTANT NOTES:
A COMPLETE BAN on the by keyword automatically disallows all tactics (simp, omega, ring, linarith, norm_num, aesop, exact, apply, intro, constructor, cases, induction, rfl as a tactic, rw, rewrite, etc.), since these can only be used within by blocks.
Eq.refl as a TERM is allowed (e.g., theorem foo : 1 = 1 := Eq.refl 1), but rfl as a STRATEGY (by rfl) is prohibited, since it contains by.
Fun x => ... is allowed as a TERM, but by intro x is prohibited.
⟨a, b⟩ is allowed as a TERM, but by constructor is prohibited.
Match x with | ... => ... is allowed as a TERM, but by cases x with | ... => ... is prohibited.
The term-style have : T := proof; body is allowed (this is syntactic sugar for (fun ( : T) => body) proof), but by have : T := ... is prohibited.
The term-style let x := e; body is allowed, but by let x := e is prohibited.
The term-style show T from proof is allowed, but by show T is prohibited.
Declaring your own axioms is prohibited, but the built-in axioms of the Lean kernel (propext, funext, Quot.sound, Quot.lift, Quot.mk, Quot.ind) are allowed.
For the float type, a noncomputable annotation may be required—this is allowed.
Write out every single character; do not abbreviate. It must be a single file. Do not write anything else except the complete code, and there must be no comments! I will never allow any simplified, mock, placeholder, dummy, simulated, sorry, axiom, or fake crap. The complete file must contain unabridged, production-ready code. Write the complete code into a single code field, and it must be 100% error-free! You are a strict zig→lean 4 transpiler. You will receive a complete zig file as input.

Output ONLY lean 4 code. 2. NO comments at all. Do not keep original comments, do not add new ones. 3. NO explanations, NO summaries, NO notes. 4. NO placeholders, NO “...rest of code”, NO “to be implemented”. 5. Do not skip or shorten ANY part. Translate EVERY line. 6.
